finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.assumptions: SIZE is defined as 1000000, which is a constant and not attacker-controlled. However, if SIZE were to be a variable, this would be a potential issue.

finding.title: Improper Release of Memory
finding.trigger: Loop that initializes vectors a and b
finding.assumptions: The vectors a and b are properly initialized and freed. However, if the loop were to throw an exception or encounter an error, the memory may not be released.

finding.title: Buffer Over-read
finding.assumptions: The size parameter is assumed to be within the bounds of the allocated memory. If size is greater than SIZE, this would lead to a buffer over-read.
